conventions.database_functions: RAISE EXCEPTION '<ERR_ code>' USING ERRCODE = '<sqlstate>'. PostgREST maps the sqlstate to HTTP (28* 403; 42501 403 when authenticated, else 401; P0001 and 22* 400; 23505 409) and returns {code: <sqlstate>, message: <ERR_ code>, details, hint}. Read the ERR_ code from `message`.
conventions.edge_functions: Body {error: {code: <ERR_ code>, request_id?}} with the listed HTTP status; every response carries an x-request-id header.
conventions.auth_hooks: Hook errors go to Supabase Auth, not to apps. Apps receive Supabase Auth error codes and map them (auth-error-mapping.json).
conventions.status: implemented = raised by backend code today (CI-checked); planned = reserved for a documented backend rule, not raised yet; client = produced by the apps only.

codes.description: Attempt to update or delete audit or consent history.
codes.client_action: Never expected; treat as a security incident (RB-07).

codes.description: Phone number outside live or beta countries; raised by the auth hooks. Apps receive a Supabase Auth error instead.
codes.client_action: See auth-error-mapping.json.

codes.description: The device is not registered to this user.
codes.client_action: Call register_device, then request a new nonce.

codes.description: A hook secret is missing in the function environment.
codes.client_action: Ops: RB-10.

codes.description: The first request with this key has not completed.
codes.client_action: Retry the same request with the same key after a short delay.

codes.description: Idempotency key missing or not 16 to 128 characters.
codes.client_action: App bug: generate keys with newIdempotencyKey().

codes.description: The key was already used for a different operation or a different payload.
codes.client_action: App bug: a new user intent needs a new key; only retries reuse one.

codes.description: The integrity nonce is unknown, expired, used, or belongs to someone else.
codes.client_action: Request a fresh nonce and repeat the integrity check.

codes.description: Unhandled server error in an Edge Function; the body carries error.request_id.
codes.client_action: Retry with backoff; show the request id if it persists.

codes.description: A required argument is missing or malformed.
codes.client_action: Treat as an app bug: log with the request id; show a generic retry message.

codes.description: A hook payload failed validation.
codes.client_action: Ops.

codes.description: A basis-point rate outside 0 to 10000.
codes.client_action: Server bug.

codes.description: A webhook failed Standard Webhooks verification.
codes.client_action: Ops: check hook secrets (RB-10).

codes.description: The language is not supported in the user's country.
codes.client_action: Offer only the languages from the country pack.

codes.description: Wrong HTTP method for an Edge Function.
codes.client_action: App bug.

codes.description: The signed-in user has no profile row.
codes.client_action: Sign out and back in; report if it persists.

codes.description: The session id is unknown, already signed out, or belongs to another user.
codes.client_action: Refresh the session list; it is already gone.

codes.description: Provider mode needs completed provider verification.
codes.client_action: Open provider onboarding (PRD SH-08).

codes.description: Every SMS provider failed for this OTP (auth-send-sms hook).
codes.client_action: Apps receive Auth's sms_send_failed; see auth-error-mapping.json.

codes.description: No SMS route or providers configured, or routes unreadable.
codes.client_action: Ops: RB-01.

codes.description: No valid session on a call that needs one.
codes.client_action: Refresh the session; if that fails, send the user to sign-in.

codes.description: A currency code missing from public.currencies.
codes.client_action: Server or configuration bug.

codes.description: The required consent (biometric or criminal-record) is missing or outdated.
codes.client_action: Show the consent screen for that kind.

codes.description: Feature switched off by a flag or not configured (RB-13).
codes.client_action: Hide the entry point; offer the fallback flow.

codes.description: The job or offer is not in a state that allows this action.
codes.client_action: Reload the job; its state changed.

codes.description: Withdrawal exceeds the available balance.
codes.client_action: Reload the wallet.

codes.description: The request or job is not in a state its customer may cancel: either already terminal, or past the free-cancellation point, after which cancelling carries fees (OD-08, OD-19).
codes.client_action: Refresh the job; offer support or a dispute rather than a retry.

codes.description: A required document expired; job acceptance blocked (PRD PR-14).
codes.client_action: Open the document renewal flow.

codes.description: Submit for review with required steps missing.
codes.client_action: Highlight the incomplete steps.

codes.description: Wrong input for the KYC step or an illegal step transition.
codes.client_action: Reload the KYC profile; the screen is stale.

codes.description: The offer TTL elapsed.
codes.client_action: Reload offers.

codes.description: The offer was accepted, declined, withdrawn or superseded meanwhile.
codes.client_action: Reload offers, for example: another provider was just selected.

codes.description: The negotiation thread reached its round limit.
codes.client_action: Offer only accept, decline or withdraw.

codes.description: The gateway reported the payment failed.
codes.client_action: Offer retry within the payment TTL.

codes.description: The payment window closed.
codes.client_action: Reload the job: it returned to negotiating or expired.

codes.description: The caller lacks the role the action needs. Used where refusing plainly is safe — the ops console — while participant-scoped reads answer *_NOT_FOUND instead, so an id cannot be probed.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message; do not retry.

codes.description: Amount above the category hard maximum for the country. The minimum viable payout check arrives with the commission rules (OD-06).
codes.client_action: Show the allowed range from the server response.

codes.description: The caller has a job of their own under way as a customer, so they cannot also go online to take work.
codes.client_action: Show the active job banner.

codes.description: A selfie check is due before going online (PRD PR-09).
codes.client_action: Launch the liveness session, then retry going online.

codes.description: The same person would be on both sides of a job.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message; never reveal the matching signal.

codes.description: No request with that id belongs to the signed-in customer.
codes.client_action: Refresh the list; it was cancelled, expired or never existed.

codes.description: The service category key is unknown or no longer active.
codes.client_action: Reload the catalogue from the bootstrap and pick again.

codes.description: Voice not available in this language (remote_config voice_languages).
codes.client_action: Fall back to the text concierge.

codes.description: A verification outcome was rejected; details are reason keys.
codes.client_action: Show the localized reason and the retry path.

codes.description: Publishing or paying needs customer verification (job lifecycle #2; review 2.14).
codes.client_action: Route to /verify/customer.

codes.description: Withdrawal under the per-currency minimum.
codes.client_action: Show the minimum from the country pack.

codes.description: App version below bootstrap min_supported_app_version.
codes.client_action: Blocking update screen (PRD SH-35).

codes.description: No response from the backend (offline, DNS, timeout).
codes.client_action: Show the offline state; retry with the same idempotency key.

codes.description: Mapped from Supabase Auth (auth-error-mapping.json).
codes.client_action: Let the user re-enter the code or resend.

codes.description: Mapped from Supabase Auth (auth-error-mapping.json).
codes.client_action: Show the retry-after time.

codes.description: An error the app cannot classify.
codes.client_action: Generic message; log with the request id.

codes.description: Vendor liveness or ID capture failed on the device.
codes.client_action: Show the retry path.

codes.description: No offer with that id is visible to the caller. Also returned when the caller is neither the customer nor the thread's provider, so an id cannot be probed.
codes.client_action: Refresh the thread.

codes.description: The same side may not counter or accept its own offer, and only the author may withdraw one.
codes.client_action: Show the thread's own actions; the counterparty has to answer first.

codes.description: The thread already has a live offer awaiting an answer.
codes.client_action: Counter or withdraw the live offer instead of sending a new one.

codes.description: The provider is serving a suspension; `suspended_until` says when it lifts.
codes.client_action: Show the suspension and its reason key; do not offer a retry.

codes.description: No city with that code in the caller's own country.
codes.client_action: Reload the city list for the country.

codes.description: The provider feed has nothing to measure distance from: no fresh position and no service area.
codes.client_action: Ask for location permission and send a heartbeat, or have the provider pick a service area.

codes.description: No job with that request id, or the caller is not its provider or worker. The same code covers both, so a job id cannot be probed.
codes.client_action: Refresh the job list.

codes.description: Too many wrong PINs for this job. A wrong PIN itself is not an error: `verify_pin` returns {verified: false, attempts_remaining}.
codes.client_action: Stop asking for the PIN; offer support or a dispute instead.

codes.description: Marking arrival from outside the pickup geofence without a reason code.
codes.client_action: Send the current position, or ask for a reason and send it with the call.

codes.description: The job cannot be completed until its required proof exists — today the delivery PIN; per-category proof sets arrive with the proofs work.
codes.client_action: Send the provider to the outstanding proof step.

codes.description: The ratings window for this job has closed (`ratings_window_hours`, 7 days by default).
codes.client_action: Hide the rating prompt; the job's reputation effect is settled.

codes.description: The chat window for this job is not open: it opens at assignment and closes a day after confirmation (`chat_window_hours_after_confirm`), except while a dispute is open.
codes.client_action: Hide the composer and say the conversation is closed; offer support.

codes.description: One of the two people has blocked the other. Symmetric, and the response never says which direction.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message. Never reveal that the other party blocked the caller, or offer to contact them another way.

codes.description: No organisation with that id is visible to the caller, or no membership row to act on.
codes.client_action: Refresh the organisation list.

codes.description: The action needs an organisation role the caller does not hold: owner for membership and vehicles, owner or dispatcher for dispatch, and self-accept enabled for a worker claiming a job.
codes.client_action: Hide the action for roles that do not have it rather than showing the error.

codes.description: The named worker is not an active member of the organisation, or is not verified and unsuspended as a provider in their own right (BU-04).
codes.client_action: Show the worker as unavailable with their verification state.

codes.description: The provider's vehicle type is banned in a zone covering the pickup (BU-09).
codes.client_action: Say which vehicle types the zone allows; the zone list is readable.

codes.description: Reserved, and not raised by the backend: `start_call` resolves a simultaneous attempt by returning the live call rather than refusing it, with `is_caller` telling the second caller they are now the callee (SH-12). Kept in case a call vendor forces a refusal instead.
codes.client_action: Do not expect it. On `start_call`, read `is_caller` and show answer or ring accordingly.

codes.description: The promo code is unknown, expired, already used, or not valid for this user or country.
codes.client_action: Show the reason next to the field and keep the order total unchanged.

codes.description: The user already has the maximum number of trusted contacts (`trusted_contacts_max`, five by default, SH-25).
codes.client_action: Ask them to remove one before adding another; show the list.

codes.description: No SOS incident with that id.
codes.client_action: Refresh the ops queue.

codes.description: That identity document is already registered to another account. One verified identity per person is a core anti-fraud control; the match is made on a blind index, so nothing reads either number.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message and route to support. Never say whose account it is, or confirm that the number exists.

codes.description: The text names something the platform does not carry (`prohibited_items`, action `block`). Deterministic and explainable: `details` carries the rule key that fired. Only requests are refused; chat and reviews are held for review instead (OD-21 fail-open).
codes.client_action: Name the rule from `details` and let them edit the text. Never retry the same text; a retry produces the same refusal.

codes.description: No moderation case with that id. Admin surfaces only.
codes.client_action: Refresh the moderation queue.

codes.description: No fraud flag with that id. Admin surfaces only; the subject of a flag can never read or reach one.
codes.client_action: Refresh the fraud queue.

codes.description: No call with that id.
codes.client_action: Close the call screen and return to the job.

codes.description: Calling is open from assignment until `chat_window_hours_after_confirm` after the job is confirmed, and stays open while a dispute is live (SH-12). Outside that window there is no call, and no PSTN fallback either.
codes.client_action: Hide the call button outside the window rather than letting it fail; if it fails anyway, say the job is over and offer support.

codes.description: Reserved for a telephony provider that exists and refuses — an exhausted number pool, or a country it does not cover. It is not raised today: `request_pstn_fallback` returns NULL when no number is allocated, because raising would roll back the `call.pstn_requested` event in the same transaction, and counting how often people reach for the phone is the only thing the seam is currently good for. No provider is contracted (REPORT §6.3).
codes.client_action: Treat a NULL return as “not available yet”: keep the user on the in-app call and do not retry in a loop. Handle this code the same way when a provider exists.
